newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia April palm oil exports 641,520t-SGS.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia April palm oil exports 641,520t-SGS.

text.p: Cargo surveyor Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) Malaysia Sdn Bhd said it estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for April at 641,520 tonnes against 608,638 tonnes in March.
It said the exports comprised 187,174 tonnes of RBD palm oil, 244,381 tonnes of RBD palm olein and 57,250 tonnes of RBD palm stearin. The other products totalled 152,715 tonnes.
India was the top buyer during the period, taking 92,670 tonnes, followed by Pakistan which bought 91,550 tonnes, China (85,676 tonnes) and Japan (31,184 tonnes).
Countries in the European Union bought 85,557 tonnes.
